headline: The India women's cricket team secured their place at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games by winning the decisive qualification series, confirming the nation's spot in the upcoming tournament.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted India's aggressive push to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining new infrastructure projects and diplomatic efforts to win the bid.
India is set to host eleven major sporting events over the next six months, with a strong focus on building momentum for the country's bid to host the 2036 Olympics.
The official Commonwealth Games 2026 website publishes India's comprehensive medals tally, listing all gold, silver and bronze medals won by Indian athletes at the Glasgow edition.
